title: review.run/v1 queue message
description: Pointer message published onto the `reviews` exchange (routing key `review.run.fast` or `review.run.deep`) and consumed by the worker (SYSTEM_DESIGN.md §7.2, PIPELINE_SPEC §12). Producers: the webhook path (webhook-api, T1), the trigger sweep in the worker leader loop (T2), rerun (portal-api, T3), the check-run close signal on cancel (webhook-api and portal-api, T6) and the reconciler (portal-api leader loop, T12, T13, T18); until the service split these roles run in the one FastAPI app and the worker process. Carries no diff or payload data: the worker reads everything else from PostgreSQL and GitHub by id, which keeps the message under 1 KB.

Uuid.description: Lowercase, unprefixed UUID (application ids are plain uuid4, no prefixes). `format: uuid` documents intent; the pattern is what actually enforces the shape, since `format` is not asserted unless the validator opts in with a FormatChecker.

CommitSha.description: Git commit SHA-1: 40 lowercase hex characters.

RequestedAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a literal 'Z' offset. `format: date-time` is not asserted by the FormatChecker (needs the optional rfc3339-validator dependency, which is out of scope here), so this ASCII-digit pattern is what actually enforces the UTC-'Z' shape; it checks the shape only, not that the calendar date or time-of-day is valid.

number.description: Pull request number on the provider.

message_id.description: Idempotency key for this message. Equal to `run_id` by construction; JSON Schema cannot assert cross-field equality, so this is enforced by the producer, not by this schema.

run_id.description: Primary key of the runs row this message claims (runs.id).

rule_version_id.description: rule_versions.id active for this repository at claim time.

prompt_version_id.description: prompt_versions.id used to build the review prompt.

attempt.description: 1-based number of the attempt the producer expects: runs.attempt + 1 at publish time, republication included. Informational: runs.attempt is the single counter and wins on mismatch (PIPELINE_SPEC §4.1).
